name: Bleed
description: Loses HP at the start of each turn.

name: Burn
description: Takes fire damage at the start of each turn.

name: Mark
description: Marked target: allies deal bonus damage to it.

name: Guard
description: Reduces damage taken; can intercept hits meant for allies.

name: Infect
description: Gains stress over time. Inflicted by mutants.

name: Overheat
description: Stats reduced by overheated implants. Caused by Cybernetic defects.

name: Shield
description: Absorbs damage before HP is lost.
